response.text:
Dear Guest,
Thank you for your wonderful review and for choosing Vinpearl Landmark 81, Autograph Collection.

We are truly honored to hear that, among the many 5-star hotels you have experienced in Ho Chi Minh City, your stay with us stands out as the best. Your recognition means a great deal to our entire team.

We are especially delighted that our service was the highlight of your visit. Delivering warm, personalized, and memorable hospitality is at the heart of everything we do, and it is rewarding to know that our associates made such a positive impression. We are also pleased that you enjoyed our modern facilities and well-appointed amenities, designed to provide both comfort and convenience throughout your stay.

Thank you once again for your kind words and recommendation. We are thrilled to know that we have earned your trust, and we look forward to welcoming you back to Vinpearl Landmark 81, Autograph Collection on your next trip to Ho Chi Minh City.

Warm regards,
Vinpearl L

Dear Guest,
Thank you for your exceptional review and, most importantly, for choosing to return to Vinpearl Landmark 81, Autograph Collection for a third visit.

We are truly delighted to know that you love everything about your experience with us. It is wonderful to hear that you enjoyed our clean and comfortable rooms, extensive facilities, convenient access to the shopping mall, and the attentive service provided by our associates. We are especially pleased that our buffet breakfast, complemented by the spectacular sky views, helped make your stay even more memorable.

Your continued loyalty and kind words mean a great deal to our team. Knowing that each visit remains a wonderful experience is the highest compliment we could receive.

We sincerely appreciate your support and look forward to welcoming you back for a fourth memorable stay in the near future.

Warm regards,
Vinpearl Landmark 81, Autograph Collection

200.description:
Agoda's most popular destination cities for travellers from an origin country (international or domestic), with city ids, country and property counts.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `destinations` as the primary payload key.

| `city_id` | number |  |
| `country` | string |  |
| `country_id` | number |  |
| `image_url` | string |  |
| `name` | string |  |
| `name_english` | string |  |
| `property_count` | number |  |
| `url` | string |  |
